## labs/nvidia/dlss5-enhancer

ComfyUI DLSS 5 Enhancer - Pushes RGBA frames and estimated motion vectors through the DLSS 5 neural renderer and returns reconstructed frames.

Status: blocked-platform. Install: none. Artifact: custom-nodes. Arm64: absent. GB10: unsupported. Comfy shape: node-pack.
Input: RGBA8 image or video plus motion vectors
Output: reconstructed and upscaled frames at 1.5x to 3x
Licenses: code MIT with a runtime carve-out for the bundled NVIDIA binaries. Weights none redistributed; the neural models are NVIDIA NGX, ReShade, and RenoDX binaries under NVIDIA driver terms. Commercial use unknown.
Footprint: 8 GB VRAM, 1 GB disk. Weights: none.
Artifact ref: https://github.com/Blueforcer/ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer
Upstream: https://github.com/Blueforcer/ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer
Also: none
Sources: https://github.com/Blueforcer/ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer

Nothing in this graph touches the GPU. The row's work runs outside the Comfy process through the operator CLI, so the App claims no occupancy and stops no heavy job: the one-heavy-job rule is the CLI's to enforce, next to the heavy confirm and the headroom preflight.

Operator verbs (host shell):
  bazelisk run //:manage -- nvidia-lab status
  bazelisk run //:manage -- nvidia-lab plan dlss5-enhancer

Canvas:
1. Preflight prints whether this Spark could run the row today - the catalog row, an aarch64 host, the binary that row's install kind needs, and the artifact ref.
2. The verdict card prints the blocking reason and the sentence that would reopen the row.
3. The tier table prints all 18 rows with their status and licenses.

Gate notes: The pack is a client of a native D3D12 worker process that hosts ReShade and must be named nvngx.dll, installed by a Windows embedded-python path against a GeForce driver. There is no Linux path at all, so it cannot run in this container. This is the same NGX wall that already declines ComfyUI_Nvidia_VFX_Nodes.
Reopen: NVIDIA ships a linux_aarch64 NGX runtime the pack can drive, which the VFX nodes row also waits on.
Verify: bazelisk test //tests:bats_nvidia_lab_test

Occupancy: none - stop nothing GPU. One GB10 job.
